_notes: D10 - Exercise and auto-break split (catalog D10, plan test-plans/journey-d/d10-exercise-and-auto-break-split.md, runner row D10). dayOffset -13 is D10's own fixture day (Journey B owns 0...-9, C -10, D6 -11, D9 -12), inside maximumDaysForTransferExport = 21.

Three time cards (07:00 time-in on the work job, 10:00 time-in on the break job with no return punch, 15:00 time-out) become four job cards once paidBreakJob designates the break job. hourlyRate 1 makes each Amount a direct decimal-hour readout; 30/15 minutes are exact in two decimals so E6 (rounding at close) is not duplicated here.

The paidBreakJob preference is shared tenant state: the flow writes it just before the transfer and restores it with 0 first thing in the after phase (null writes are ignored by the partial PUT). The 'unremovable' entry below only declares that restore; the code that performs it is journeyDFlow.finishCleanup.

annotations.description: Other Create Break Card / Auto Return variants, a break start that has a return punch, and a meal break are separate tickets (one happy path per workflow). Decimal-hour rounding at close belongs to E6.
